items.text: Round 3 decisions were incorporated into the conclusion. d1 (code-split per dashboard page) is now Finding 15 and is woven into Summary, Finding 11 (fade transitions absorb the import latency), Finding 13 (precedent comparison), Action 2 (scaffold scope), and Limitations (bundle budget still unset even with splitting).

d2 (controller input) was answered 'Other' with the user correction that the react-vite template already bundles @vrooli/iframe-bridge spatial navigation and gamepad hooks (useGamepad, useSpatialNav, SpatialGroup). This was verified against packages/iframe-bridge/src/{gamepadInput.ts, spatialNav.ts, spatialNavBridge.ts} and templates/scenarios/react-vite/ui. The conclusion was restructured: Finding 12's former 'gamepad is a gap' bullet was removed; the new Finding 16 documents the consume-from-template path; the Methodology gained step 11 covering the template inspection; Limitations now note the need for an Xbox smoke test of spatial nav rather than new work; the former Action 5 'Gamepad input handling is new work' was rewritten as 'Consume @vrooli/iframe-bridge spatial navigation from the react-vite template'.

d3 (upstream-down UX) is now Finding 17 — subtle per-widget staleness with no global takeover. Finding 14 gained a staleness-badge verification entry; Action 6 was added to assign per-theme staleness-badge visuals to the theming-engine execute item and to lock in the cache envelope contract (staleness_ts, from_cache) the UI reads.

Readiness moved from 3/3/3/2/3 to 3/3/3/3/3. Testable now reaches 3 because Finding 14 comprehensively identifies verification paths for every major deliverable, including the two new items added this round (spatial navigation and staleness UX). The research's responsibility is to identify verification approaches per deliverable; translating those into concrete test matrices remains the job of the execute-item plans, and that work is explicitly scoped in Action 3.

No open questions remain in this research item. All downstream owed work is captured as pointers: Action 1 owns the LPBS endpoint contracts (depends on research/command-center-data-aggregation-design), Action 3 owns the scaffold testing section, Action 4 the Wake Lock + Fullscreen hook lift, Action 5 the spatial-nav consumption, Action 6 the per-theme staleness visuals and cache envelope contract. The item is ready to transition to status=ready.

plan_updates: Finalize pass: (1) wrote Finding 15 capturing the per-dashboard React.lazy code-splitting decision and threaded it through Summary/Finding 11/Finding 13/Action 2/Limitations; (2) replaced the gamepad-as-new-work framing with Finding 16 documenting iframe-bridge spatial navigation consumed from the react-vite template, updated Methodology step 11, pruned Finding 12's obsolete gamepad bullet, and rewrote Action 5 to match; (3) wrote Finding 17 documenting the subtle per-widget staleness strategy, added a Finding 14 verification entry for the staleness badge, added Action 6 assigning per-theme staleness visuals to the theming-engine item, and noted the remaining staleness-design gap in Limitations; (4) re-scored testable from 2 to 3 now that verification paths cover every deliverable including the two added this round.
